title: Low-Wage Workers and the Enforceability of Noncompete Agreements
eligible_reason: Single treated unit and single adoption date: the 2008 Oregon ban on noncompete agreements for hourly-paid workers, compared with other states (and with salaried workers). Not a staggered design.
design_notes: Abstract: effects of the 2008 Oregon low-wage NCA ban on hourly wages, occupational status, job-to-job mobility and hours, with heterogeneity by gender, age, education and NCA-prevalent occupations.
